observations.detail: Public page links to 2024, 2025 and 2026 PeruEduca allocations.
Unauthenticated browser rendered catalogue shell with no materials. Sampled API requests returned HTTP 401; no authentication was attempted.
Search-index catalogue was available; direct HTTP retrieval was forbidden. Do not interpret this as proof the books do not exist.
Sampled record and PDF URLs returned Check Point security HTML rather than the requested content.
HTTP response had 15,323 bytes and text/html; rejected as a PDF.
Published link found via Tu Amawta; no valid PDF retrieved.
Parsed 150 Quechua-related rows with official PeruEduca file URLs. Blog attribution is not independent verification of government ownership. Links not individually tested are labelled not_attempted.

Seven index pages; 377 entries, including one excluded Shawi misclassification. Remaining 376 entries resolve to 628 public Google Drive PDF links. Publisher and content are checked from PDFs separately from mirror metadata.
Individually checked Central, Chanka and Inkawasi-Kanaris Grades 1-6. Per-file status and UTC check time are retained in official-url-leads-2022.json.
